messages:
Harper Lee: quick runthrough of the Roles grid tweaks 12 user reports about confusing inherited-role pill and the remove affordance being too easy. Thoughts?
Marcus Liu: agree. require confirmation for bulk role removal. show a toast with 'Undo (20s)' that reverts server-side pending invites/changes.
Fiona Zhang: a11y: revoke dialog must trap focus and SR announce the question exactly: 'Revoke roles from X members?' link error summary with aria-describedby for inline errors.
Diego Morales: density control idea: Compact / Comfortable toggle in top-right of matrix. Default to Comfortable for new orgs, keep Compact as opt-in for power users.
Harper Lee: microcopy: replace 'Remove roles' with 'Revoke roles' and modal heading -> 'Revoke roles from members'. clearer and matches audit language.
Marcus Liu: inherited-pill should be icon + label 'Inherited' not color-only. tooltip: 'Inherited from: Team > DevOps' and show which permissions are inherited on hover.
Fiona Zhang: contrast note: green chips failing 4.5:1 on cards. add 1px outline + bold text; run color-blind sims (deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia). and never use color as sole indicator.
Diego Morales: add a small 'why?' inline link next to the pill that opens a lightweight popover with source, inherited bits, and "since" date. keep popover keyboard reachable.
Harper Lee: action items: Marcus -> undo toast + confirm flow; Fiona -> SR test plan + updated copy; Diego -> density toggle mock + popover. I'll review Figma once uploaded. :memo:
A11yBot: checklist created (#A11Y-501): revoke dialog focus trap, aria-live for undo, contrast >= 4.5:1, no color-only indicators.
